shared_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game inventory item icon, transparent PNG cutout for a Roblox inventory UI. Style: polished stylized 3D game art, chunky low-poly forms with softly beveled edges, carefully shaped simple silhouette, subtle hand-painted material gradients, premium playful adventure-game feel, never emoji/flat glyph/photorealism. Orthographic three-quarter product view, centered isolated single item, fills 80% of a square canvas with equal padding on every side, entire item visible. Soft studio light from upper left, clean readable highlights and subtle ambient occlusion on the object itself, no ground or cast shadow outside the object. True transparent background. Must read clearly at 64x64 and still look detailed at 160x160. No lettering, labels, numbers, logos, watermark, frame, panel, slot, UI, border, decorative sparkles, scene or floor. Cohesive cool steel-blue / warm leather / soft gold material language. 1024x1024 square image.
